info.headline: Notify NYC - Missing Vulnerable Adult Alert - Zelal Mohammad (NYC)
info.description:
Alert issued 10-10-2026 at 11:33 AM.
A Missing Vulnerable Adult Alert has been issued for Zelal Mohammad, a 63-year-old Asian male from Queens, NY. The missing may be in need of medical attention.
Description: 5'5" tall, 160lbs, with black hair and brown eyes. Wearing a dark colored beanie, black hooded sweatshirt, blue plaid pajama pants and blue slippers.
Last Seen: Walking on 126th Street in Queens, NY at approximately 1:45 PM on 10-09-2026.
If you see the missing person, please call the NYPD Precinct 106 at (800) 577-8477 or call 9-1-1.
A photo of the missing is available here: https://flic.kr/p/2sFnQtc
